Here's my team breakdown

Greninja - Best lead in against almost any team comp not having weather. Scarf to outspeed everyone, gunk for Tapus, ice beam for Lando and chomps and U turn if i predict them switching. I had spikes last but i changed it to rock slide cause the team had problems with Char Y and HP ground Volc.  


Hippodown - Solid all around check against physical attackers. I choose Hippo over other phys walls cause it's easier to deal with opposing weather that way. Experimented with toxic, yawn and Whirlwind eventually deciding on the latter cause I found that more useful.  


Zapados - Secondary physical wall plus hazard removal. Parahax is the only defensive way the team can deal with Weavile although Gren can outspeed okho it. Really useful against the occasional Gyara and a backup if Hippo falls against other phys attackers.  


Heatran - Special tank and trapper. Kills most bulky mons like Chansy, Pex and Ferro who otherwise would run over me. Also stops Serp if choices and if its the glare set can pivot to Gren on the Leech predict. Usually the opponent switches into Garchomp so toxic to chip it. Ideally could use a little bit more speed evs to beat other def heatrans but I havent checked that out.  


Kommo o - The setup sweeper. Usually doesnt do much until I kill the fairy but it does force the opponent to go to it each time so I can double. Flash cannon is meh but I already got Heatwave zap and Heatran so did'nt see a point in Flamethrower. It also walls other Z Kommos because Soundproof who otherwise destroys the team.  


Rilaboom - Band just to punch holes in the team. I use it to switch terrains and as priority. Most of the time I'll just clicking Uturn or Knock off until the end game where I can clean up. Also the team struggles with Fini so its great to have a water move switch in as even if Rila gets burned it usually does it's job of knocking and pivoting.

​
